### 1. What the user expresses and how the simulator behaves

Rosalind opens: she wants to pay **her share of the storage on the EV6 up to today, with her own card, and nothing more**. Target object: the storage owner share on the EV6 booking; timing: up to today (statement date = 2026-10-19); action boundary: pay her share only (not Granite Shield's part — "that is between the shop and Granite Shield"); authorisation: she pays herself by Visa card. She gives name + phone when asked, PIN as second detail. She passively accepts "something has to be put on your account or worked out on the shop's side before you can pay" ("that is fine, go ahead"), thanks for any courtesy, and pays the exact amount handed to her through the user-side payment tool. The vehicle is not leaving today. The simulator only conveys needs and responds conditionally; it executes the payment tool only when handed over.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse, with eligibility grounds

Act now. Grounds: identity can be verified (`verify_customer_identity` description: "The identity must be verified before any business is transacted… passes only when at least two of them match"; phone 7205550137 + PIN 1482 both match). The booking is an insurance-claim booking on a teardown type with storage ("Only the two teardown types store vehicles", `vehicle_storage_rates`), vehicle not released, decline confirmed (`decline_and_vehicle_release`). Owner storage payment applies "On a Repair Estimates & Appointments insurance-claim booking … the owner settles the owner's part of a storage statement charge with one payment of their own on that charge" (`owner_storage_payment`). Lien referral (30 days of accrued storage) is not reached: free storage ran to 2026-10-05, 14 billed days by 2026-10-19 — not a desk-excluded lien case. Release is not asked for and not required.

  = 9 free storage days.

**(b) Storage goodwill** (`storage_goodwill_amount` baseline + factors):
- Goodwill percentage: (a) claim_customer_payment 500.00 on her own Insurance Claim Repairs order + (b) card payment of the scan charge on this booking -> both -> 6% (`goodwill_percentage_by_paying_record`). 6% × 1487.50 = 89.25.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root problem (customer's own write, user-owned): owner payment toward the storage statement.

- Hop 1 (root -> storage statement posted): `owner_storage_payment` states "The owner's payment toward a storage statement is worked out only after the booking carries a storage charge billing every day from the end of the free storage days through the statement date." `find_estimate_events` shows no `storage` fee on the booking -> state unmet. Searching with the sentence's words ("storage charge", "billed days", "statement date") finds `storage_statement_posting` ("it is posted as one storage charge dated on the statement date. The statement covers the billed storage days from its first billed day through its last billed day, both included") and the computation `storage_statement_charge_amount` ("The first billed day … is the day after the last free storage day and its last billed day is the statement date"). Mark: **state-derived**.
- Hop 2 (root -> storage goodwill booked on that charge): `owner_storage_payment` states "The owner's payment toward a storage statement is not fixed until that storage charge carries the storage goodwill booked on storage statements." No waiver exists on any storage charge. `storage_goodwill_waiver` describes the write: "Every … storage statement charge carries the storage goodwill the desk books … it is booked as one goodwill waiver against that storage charge." Mark: **state-derived**.
- Hop 3 (storage goodwill -> storage statement posted): `storage_goodwill_waiver` states "Storage goodwill is worked out only once the storage charge it relieves stands on the booking." Same write as hop 1. Mark: **state-derived**.
- Resulting order: post storage statement -> book storage goodwill on it -> owner pays her share. Direction: payment waits on goodwill and on statement; goodwill waits on statement. The goodwill figure also needs the statement amount (specialised-rate relief and 6% of the charge), consistent with the order.
- No pre-solved hop: no document names another problem's tool beside these sentences; each tool name appears only in its own "How it is invoked" block.

- Closest alternative statement date / period: the retired clause "the last billed day is the vehicle released date … one storage charge on the release date" is marked "no longer in force" (`vehicle_storage_accrual`); the vehicle is not released; the current basis bills through the statement date — so a statement through 2026-10-19 (today) is the in-force basis.
- Responsibility date candidates: confirmation date 2026-10-12 (baseline) vs request date 2026-10-08 — the bulletin moves it because confirmation came 4 days (> 2) after request.
- Grace radius candidates: service distance 14.2 and tow miles 14.2 are both within 25 -> 2 grace days either way.
- Goodwill already booked: 60.00 on the teardown charge would cut authority left to 190.00 (< 214.25) under the baseline; the ruling for a confirmed decline counts only goodwill against this storage statement charge -> 0.00 counted.
- Goodwill sharing: pro-rata (214.25 × 6/14 = 91.82) under the baseline vs owner-first under the ruling for a confirmed decline -> 214.25.
- Returning-owner warranty is on the CR-V, not the EV6: the term reads "the owner's Workmanship Warranties coverages" (owner-level), so it counts; the ended_by_sale coverage is not active.
- "Do only the one thing the customer asked for" (hand her the payment tool now): there is no storage charge on the booking to quote a `charge_event_id` against, and `owner_storage_payment` says the owner's payment is "worked out only after" the storage charge exists and "not fixed until" it carries the storage goodwill; paying without goodwill would also make her pay 887.50 instead of 673.25. Excluded by the visible prerequisite sentences + the empty storage rows.
- Paying Granite Shield's part or releasing the vehicle: outside the request; release is not asked for.
